purpose: Define independent evidence needed to claim useful 100-200 m REA-L-to-HICAR downscaling, while keeping driver consistency separate from observational skill.
principles: REA-L comparisons test source consistency and large-scale inheritance; they are not independent validation.
HICAR and REA-L must be evaluated against the same observations, times, sampling operator, and quality-control mask.
Scores must be stratified by season, elevation, terrain exposure, land class, and distance from the HICAR boundary.
Event pilots diagnose gross behavior; monthly and annual samples are required for bias, drift, distribution, and added-value decisions.
Numerical acceptance thresholds will be frozen before launching the annual-cycle qualification, not tuned on its results.

surface_temperature.sampling: Station comparison uses the model grid cell containing the station with a documented elevation correction reported both on and off; TabsD uses common-grid daily aggregates.
surface_temperature.known_reference_issue: REA-L evaluation reports warm cold-pool valleys and cold high elevations, especially in winter; elevation stratification is mandatory.

precipitation.sampling: Compare common daily accumulation for RhiresD and event/hourly accumulation where CombiPrecip or station sampling is available.
metrics: fraction skill score at application-relevant neighbourhood scales
precipitation.known_reference_issue: Gauge undercatch, representativeness, and radar degradation in complex terrain require dataset-specific masks and uncertainty reporting.

shortwave_radiation.sampling: Use station point sampling and daily common-grid aggregates; evaluate clear-sky and cloudy subsets separately.
shortwave_radiation.known_reference_issue: Station-to-grid comparisons in the Alps are sensitive to unresolved horizon shading; the gridded no-horizon product and terrain-shadow effects must not be conflated.

primary: independent exposed-ridge and valley station subsets
wind.sampling: Apply station exposure and measurement-height metadata. Compare vector components, speed, and direction from the hourly-mean channels. Treat fkl010h1 as a separate hourly maximum of one-second wind; compare it with a HICAR extreme only after explicitly harmonizing the HICAR diagnostic support duration and sampling cadence.
wind.policy: ICON VMAX is excluded as a HICAR output target. HICAR sampled interval maxima are not gusts. A HICAR-native three-second gust diagnostic must not be relabeled or compared directly with the one-second fkl010h1 observation without an explicit duration-harmonization method and held-out upper-tail validation.

primary: available gridded or remotely sensed snow-cover and snow-water-equivalent products
snow.sampling: Evaluate snow depth, snow-cover duration, onset, melt-out date, and SWE where available, stratified by elevation and exposure.
metrics: snow-depth bias and root mean squared error

72_hour_events: Complete all structural, solver, physical-range, water, and surface-energy diagnostics.
Run observation comparisons where hourly or daily data access is already operational; do not block the structural event verdict solely on unavailable long-period observations.
31_day_pilot: Establish reproducible access to at least station temperature/wind, RhiresD precipitation, and one radiation reference.
Freeze sampling and quality-control code and report HICAR-versus-observation and REA-L-versus-observation side by side.
Characterize spin-up separately from retained statistics.
annual_cycle: Freeze numerical acceptance thresholds and application weights before execution.
Cover all seasons and the declared elevation/exposure classes.
Demonstrate that claimed added value is robust across independent subsets rather than a single event.

acceptance_design.absolute_quality: Each application will declare maximum acceptable bias, RMSE, distribution error, and event error before annual execution.
acceptance_design.added_value: At identical observational samples, compare HICAR and REA-L errors and confidence intervals; finer visual structure alone is not added value.
acceptance_design.drift: Test monthly and seasonal tendencies after the declared spin-up period for soil water, snow, canopy storage, surface energy residual, and near-surface climate.
acceptance_design.failure_policy: A systematic degradation across both seasons or a persistent unexplained storage/energy trend blocks production escalation.

annual_acceptance_thresholds.purpose: Freeze independently justified application-specific absolute quality limits and application weights after the event and month pipelines establish feasible metrics, but before an annual-cycle run can reveal the seasonal result; limits must not be chosen merely to pass the pilot.

temperature: station and TabsD root mean squared error
daily minimum and maximum quantile error
precipitation: station and RhiresD root mean squared error
wind: station vector root mean squared error
snow: snow-depth bias and root mean squared error

annual_acceptance_thresholds.interpretation: UNRESOLVED blocks GO_ANNUAL_CYCLE. Relative HICAR-versus-REA-L non-degradation is necessary but is not an application-quality threshold.

access_state.balfrin: SwissMetNet hourly observations are reproducibly available through the operational JRetrieve PROD wrapper using station group SMN, DWH data-quality category 4, and use limitation 50. The summer and winter event publications each contain 158 station abbreviations and retain their raw internal-use CSV only in the event scratch tree. Public MeteoSwiss OGD STAC archives now provide checksum-verified 2020 RhiresD, TabsD, hourly SIS, and hourly SIS-No-Horizon NetCDF assets on Balfrin. A historical CombiPrecip/CPC path remains unavailable and is optional rather than a substitute for the operational RhiresD event reference.
access_state.station_data_policy: DWH use limitation 50 is internal-only. Do not copy the raw CSV into a public repository or external archive; retain a checksum-bearing manifest and derived aggregate validation report.
access_state.next_action: Complete both event station and OGD-grid comparisons, then freeze retained-period, spin-up, and sampling diagnostics before the 31-day pilot.
blocker_for: any claim of 100-200 m observational added value
